meta: Aqua NYC took 71 schedules on $1,905, about $27 each, just outside the $25 good mark and the most efficient of the three.
Hutong Miami rose to 32 schedules on $1,847 (about $58 each) and Hutong NYC to 22 on $1,032 (about $47); both are at or past the $50 poor mark.
Volumes moved the right way at both Hutongs week on week (Miami 19 to 32, NYC 18 to 22) while Aqua NYC fell from 84 to 71.
google: Google booking conversions read 23 at Aqua NYC, 24 at Hutong NYC and 15 at Hutong Miami, giving CPAs of about $24, $56 and $43.
Those figures are not fully attributed yet. Re-pulling last week now returns 48, 38 and 23 against the 41, 36 and 18 published, so this week's Google CPAs will settle materially lower.
Even allowing for that, Hutong NYC's Google spend is 79 percent above last year while conversions are well down, which is the clearest efficiency concern in the market.
ga4: Aqua NYC fell to 201 (-22.4% WoW, -32.1% YoY) with users up 17.6 percent year on year, so the shortfall is conversion, not traffic.
Hutong NYC booked 139 (-35.3% YoY) with users down 15.7 percent, and Hutong Miami 112 (-15.8% YoY) with users down 6.3 percent; Miami was the only venue to grow week on week.
Engagement rate fell at all three venues for a third week running and Unassigned sessions jumped again, which looks systemic rather than venue specific and is worth a tagging check.
